beat: Bantu arrives: apology, long hug and lace-stitch clarification

lines.original: She quickly looked for the T shirt that she threw away but couldn't find it... but saw another loose T shirt lying around... she wore it quickly and tip toed to check who it was....
lines.local: Dhika ne pehle pheki hui T-shirt dhoondhi, nahi mili. Paas padi doosri dheeli T-shirt jaldi pehni aur dabey paon darwaze par dekhne gayi.

lines.original: Dhika opened the door and gave him a faint smile...
lines.local: Usne darwaza kholkar halki-si smile di.
Dhika: Hey dear... usne dheemi awaaz mein kaha.

lines.original: Bantu: miss...may I come in.. he asked politely and little worried....
lines.local: Bantu: Miss, kya main andar aa sakta hoon? Usne adab se, thoda pareshan hokar poochha.

lines.original: Dhika pulled him in and gave him a deep hug........
lines.local: Dhika ne use andar kheenchkar gehra hug diya.

lines.original: Bantu, feeling more confused, just patted her back.... it was more than a minute when she released him...
lines.local: Bantu aur confuse hua, bas uski peeth thapthapata raha; ek minute se zyada baad usne hug chhoda.
Bantu: Miss, aap ro kyun rahi hain?

lines.original: Dhika: wiping her little tears... am sorry for showing my anger dear...its..... its just not me...
lines.local: Dhika: Chhote aansu ponchte hue—sorry dear, tum par gussa dikhaya. Yeh... yeh meri fitrat nahi hai.

lines.original: Bantu: its okay miss....but what happened....
lines.local: Bantu: Koi baat nahi miss, par hua kya?

lines.original: Dhika: I just thought something wrong and felt angry quickly....
lines.local: Dhika: Maine kuch galat soch liya aur jaldi gussa aa gaya.

lines.original: Bantu too thought she got angry because they saw her nipples....
lines.local: Bantu ne bhi socha ki use gussa isliye aaya kyunki unhone uske nipples dekhe the.

lines.original: Bantu: sorry miss... I know why you got angry... he put his head down...
lines.local: Bantu: Sorry miss, mujhe pata hai aapko gussa kyun aaya. Woh sir jhukakar bola.

lines.original: Dhika: snorting a laugh while rubbing her eyes... no no dear.... its not what you think at all..... look......
lines.local: Dhika aankhein malte hue halki hansi—nahi nahi dear, tum jo soch rahe ho woh bilkul baat nahi hai. Dekho...

lines.original: To his utter surprise.... she pulled her loose T shirt forward and made him peek into her T shirt... Bantu noticed what she was showing... it was just how the cloth stitch looked and not her nipples... he felt a little sad..
lines.local: Bantu ke liye hairaani thi: Dhika ne apni dheeli T-shirt aage kheenchkar use andar jhaankne diya. Bantu ne dekha ki nipple jaisa dikhne wala hissa sirf kapde ki stitching thi, asli nipple nahi. Use thodi mayoosi hui.

lines.original: Dhika: realizing how she is showing her bra to him.... oops... hehe... she bit her tongue and left her T shirt back but it hung loosely... top part of her transparent portion of one bra cup was still visible....
lines.local: Dhika ko achanak ehsaas hua ki woh use apni bra dikha rahi hai—oops, hehe. Jeebh daantkar T-shirt chhod di, par woh dheeli latak gayi; ek bra cup ke transparent upar wale hisse ka kuch part abhi bhi dikh raha tha.
Bantu: Hehe, mujhe toh koi shikayat nahi miss.

lines.original: Dhika: aii.. hehe..I know you won't
lines.local: Dhika: Aii, hehe, mujhe pata hai tumhe nahi hogi.
